title: 4. What themes are you drawn to?
use_cases: Use when defining the thematic foundation of a mystery novel
Configure when establishing the emotional promise for a target audience
Implement when deciding between restoration-focused or justice-focused narrative arcs
Use when blending elements from different sub-genres to ensure stylistic clarity
content:
Hope and restoration → Cozy

Justice in a flawed world → Hard-boiled

Both cozy mysteries and hard-boiled detective novels demand strong plotting, compelling suspects, and a satisfying resolution. But the feeling of the journey—the cadence of your sentences, the way your characters navigate conflict, the atmosphere you build around the investigation—defines which genre your story lives in.

You don’t have to choose forever. Many writers blend elements or switch depending on the project. What matters is clarity: when you sit down to write, know the emotional promise you’re making to your reader.
